design_principle_verified: SourceOperationPlan is generic and source-agnostic; the module never decides what a particular source's plan is. Row-data MODE and reader ENCODING are independent: a non-null encoding is passed to the reader configuration and can never select a row-data mode.

C5_METADATA_ONLY_with_non_null_encoding.evidence: run(METADATA_ONLY, encoding='latin1') -> metadata_reads=1, selected_reads=0, full_reads=0, chunk_reads=0
C5_METADATA_ONLY_with_non_null_encoding.significance: this closes the HQ199-identified hazard where a declared-encoding source (SRC08/SRC12) drifted into a full row-data read; the encoding is now strictly reader configuration

C6_SELECTED.binding_order: selected names are bound against the REAL column inventory from the metadata read BEFORE any row-data read; absent names raise SELECTED_VARIABLES_ABSENT with selected_reads still 0

C7_FULL.note: FULL issues one full reader invocation and drives only the full_reads account; it does not silently emit chunk reads

C8_CHUNKED_FULL.evidence: metadata_reads=1, selected_reads=0, full_reads=0, chunk_reads=3 on a 300-row carrier at chunk_rows=100
C8_CHUNKED_FULL.important: chunk_reads does NOT increment full_reads. This matters for the HQ200 rule that 'chunk_reads cannot silently satisfy the frozen full-read floor' — the accounts are kept distinct. A plan that must satisfy SRC27's full-read FLOOR must use FULL (or otherwise record a full read); CHUNKED_FULL alone would not.

mode_to_account_map_enforced.verified: each mode drove exactly its own account and zero of the others in every trial

C9_C10_header_prefix.design: header-prefix access is deferred to _finish() and gated by plan.admits_header_prefix, so it occurs only when the plan declares a size
C9_C10_header_prefix.significance: closes the HQ199-identified defect where _decode read a prefix unconditionally for every source and format, including an invented 512-byte DTA prefix

C13_no_SRCxx_policy_hard_coded_in_produc.evidence: scanned the three production modules for SRC02/SRC06/SRC08/SRC12/SRC14/SRC26/SRC27/SRC35 outside comments: zero occurrences in code. The single session-module hit is a comment stating explicitly that nothing there encodes SRCxx policy.
C13_no_SRCxx_policy_hard_coded_in_produc.significance: source-specific plans must come from the warrant-binding layer, which is the correct separation

verified_refusals: selected_variables supplied on a non-SELECTED mode -> SessionPlanError
plan_validation_guardrails.result: PASS — malformed plans are rejected before execution
